subject: Exciting Job Opportunity at XYZ Company
body: Dear John, I am reaching out to inform you about an exciting job opportunity at XYZ Company that I believe aligns perfectly with your skills and experience. We are currently hiring for the position of Senior Marketing Manager, and I think you would be a great fit for the role based on your previous work in the industry. If you are interested in learning more about the position, please let me know and I can provide you with further details. Looking forward to hearing from you! Best regards, Sarah
